scopes_needed_read: None: ClickUp OAuth apps have no scope picker; access is the authorizing user's workspaces (status file clickup.json)
auth.token_lifetime: Access token currently does not expire ('subject to change' per ClickUp docs)

access_requirements.app_review_or_marketplace_listing: None for OAuth on unlisted apps (status file: nothing to submit); App Directory listing UNVERIFIED
access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Workspace member authorizes the LOVELEEDAY app and picks the workspaces to share; access equals that user's permissions.

sandbox.how_to_get: No separate sandbox; Free Forever workspace 'Loveleedaystudios' used for testing

rate_limits: 100 requests/min on Free Forever, Unlimited and Business; 1,000/min on Business Plus; 10,000/min on Enterprise; 429 with X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset (Unix time)
incremental_sync: GET /list/{id}/task with date_updated_gt (Unix ms), 100 tasks per page, include_closed and subtasks off by default
blockers: Redirect field stores only the origin https://portal.loveleedaystudios.com; the localhost URL was not retained (redirect_uris_set: partial).
No scope picker means read-only cannot be enforced at the token level; enforce in our adapter.
